lines.beaver: 이번 제주도 여행, 일주를 할까, 한 곳에 머물까?
lines.beaver_en: For our Jeju trip, should we go around the island or stay in one place?
lines.beaver_roman: Ibeon jejudo yeohaeng, iljureul halkka, han gose meomulkka?
lines.learner: 섬 일주도 좋지만, 명소만 도는 건 바쁘기 짝이 없어.
lines.en: A tour of the island is nice, but just hitting famous spots is way too hectic.
lines.roman: Seom iljudo jochiman, myeongsoman doneun geon bappeugi jjagi eopseo.

lines.beaver: 그럼 체류형으로 할까? 서귀포에 오래 있는 거야.
lines.beaver_en: Then should we just stay put? We'd stay in Seogwipo for a while.
lines.beaver_roman: Geureom cheryuhyeongeuro halkka? Seogwipoe orae inneun geoya.
lines.learner: 좋아. 서귀포에서 체류하면 해수욕도 실컷 하겠다.
lines.en: Sounds good. If we stay in Seogwipo, we can swim in the sea all we want.
lines.roman: Joa. Seogwipoeseo cheryuhamyeon haesuyokdo silkeot hagetda.

lines.beaver: 해변에서 일광욕도 하자. 나는 그게 제일 좋아.
lines.beaver_en: Let's sunbathe on the beach too. That's my favorite.
lines.beaver_roman: Haebyeoneseo ilgwangyokdo haja. Naneun geuge jeil joa.
lines.learner: 그래. 그런데 바다니 숲이니 하다가 결정을 못 했잖아.
lines.en: Sure. But we went back and forth between the sea and the forest and never decided.
lines.roman: Geurae. Geureonde badani supini hadaga gyeoljeongeul mot haetjana.

lines.beaver: 맞아. 하루는 한라산 숲길을 걸어 보는 건 어때?
lines.beaver_en: Right. How about spending one day walking the Hallasan forest trails?
lines.beaver_roman: Maja. Haruneun hallasan supgireul georeo boneun geon eottae?
lines.learner: 좋아, 숲 탐험도 재미있겠다. 나침반도 챙길게.
lines.en: Great, exploring the forest sounds fun. I'll bring a compass too.
lines.roman: Joa, sup tamheomdo jaemiitgetda. Nachimbando chaenggilge.

lines.beaver: 길이 잘 표시돼 있어서 괜찮을 거야. 숙소는?
lines.beaver_en: The trails are well marked, so it'll be fine. What about lodging?
lines.beaver_roman: Giri jal pyosidwae isseoseo gwaenchaneul geoya. Suksoneun?
lines.learner: 숙식이 다 되는 민박이 편할 것 같아.
lines.en: I think a guesthouse with room and board would be easiest.
lines.roman: Suksigi da doeneun minbagi pyeonhal geot gata.

lines.beaver_en: It'd be nice if they serve breakfast and dinner.
lines.learner: 응, 예약 가능 여부부터 오늘 확인해 볼게.
lines.en: Yeah, I'll check today whether we can book first.
lines.roman: Eung, yeyak ganeung yeobubuteo oneul hwaginhae bolge.

lines.beaver: 참, 민지도 같이 가고 싶대. 괜찮아?
lines.beaver_en: Oh, Minji says she wants to come too. Is that okay?
lines.beaver_roman: Cham, minjido gachi gago sipdae. Gwaenchana?
lines.learner: 물론이지. 민지가 동행하면 더 즐거울 거야.
lines.en: Of course. It'll be more fun if Minji comes along.
lines.roman: Mulloniji. Minjiga donghaenghamyeon deo jeulgeoul geoya.

lines.beaver_en: Minji wants to bring her dog too, though.
lines.en: I'd better ask the guesthouse whether pets are allowed.

lines.beaver: 고마워. 그럼 전체 일정을 정리해 줄래?
lines.beaver_en: Thanks. Then can you sum up the whole schedule?
lines.beaver_roman: Gomawo. Geureom jeonche iljeongeul jeongnihae jullae?
lines.learner: 첫날 해수욕, 둘째 날 숲길, 셋째 날 명소 구경이야.
lines.en: Day one is swimming, day two the forest trail, day three sightseeing.
lines.roman: Cheonnal haesuyok, duljjae nal supgil, setjjae nal myeongso gugyeongiya.

lines.beaver_en: Perfect! I'm really looking forward to this trip.
lines.learner: 나도! 이번 여행은 정말 즐거울 거야.
lines.en: Me too! This trip is going to be really fun.
lines.roman: Nado! Ibeon yeohaengeun jeongmal jeulgeoul geoya.
